title: Where things are
goal: Say where things are, give simple directions, and say whose something is.
tip: Gujarati puts "in, on, from, of" after the word: ઘરમાં (in the house), ટેબલ પર (on the table), રવિનું ઘર (Ravi's house). Before them a word ending in ો or ું usually changes to ા: રસ્તો → રસ્તામાં, મારું → મારા માટે.

items.notes: Written onto the end of a word: ઘરમાં = in the house, શહેરમાં = in the city.
Written as a separate word: ટેબલ પર = on the table.
Joined like માં: શહેરથી = from the city, ઘરેથી = from home.
Borrowed from English, like many everyday words.

items.english: The book is on the table.
The bus is on the way.
items.notes: રસ્તો (road) becomes રસ્તા before માં. Words ending in ો change this way before a postposition.

alts: He is coming from the city
She is coming from the city

items.notes: Also "on top of" or "above": ટેબલની ઉપર.
Also "downstairs". ટેબલ નીચે = under the table.
અંદર આવો! = come in!
ઘરની બહાર = outside the house.
Also "has": મારી પાસે પૈસા છે = I have money.

items.english: The temple is near the market.
items.notes: પાસે can follow the word directly, as here, or come after ની: બજારની પાસે. Both are common.
Usually after ની: ઘરની પાછળ = behind the house.
The opposite of પાછળ.
સીધા જાઓ = go straight on.

items.english: on the left, to the left
items.notes: Literally "the left side". બાજુ = side.

items.english: on the right, to the right
items.notes: Literally "the right side".

items.gujarati: સીધા જાઓ, પછી ડાબી બાજુ વળો.
items.translit: seedhaa jaao, pachhee Daabee baaju vaLo.
items.english: Go straight on, then turn left.
alts: Go straight on then turn to the left
items.notes: જાઓ = go and વળો = turn, both polite commands.

items.english: The school is ahead on the right.
alts: The school is up ahead on the right

items.notes: Joined to the owner and matched to the thing owned: રવિનું ઘર (ઘર is neuter).
રવિની બહેન = Ravi's sister.
રવિનો ભાઈ = Ravi's brother. નો and નું become ના before plurals and elders (રવિના પપ્પા) and before a word with a postposition (રવિના ઘરમાં).
મારી સાથે = with me; મિત્ર સાથે = with a friend.
મારા માટે = for me, તમારા માટે = for you.
તમારું becomes તમારા before માટે.

alts: Meera's sister is in the school

items.english: Ravi's brother is behind the house.

items.gujarati: હું મારા મિત્ર સાથે બજાર જાઉં છું.
items.translit: hun maaraa mitra saathe bajaar jaaun chhun.
items.english: I am going to the market with my friend.
alts: I go to the market with my friend
I'm going to the market with my friend

items.notes: રવિના, not રવિનો: પપ્પા takes the respectful plural.
